name: REGISTRY_RUNTIME_TRUTH_SYSTEMD_LQ62_20261107
comment: ANCHOR: REGISTRY_RUNTIME_TRUTH_SYSTEMD_LQ62_20261107 — LQ-20261107-62, the checker that disagrees with
crontab in 7 places. check_registry_runtime_truth joined the registry with the crontab, the n8n workflow
table and the ledger but never read systemd, so 168 kind:systemd rows were unverified in both directions
and one program under two live schedulers was invisible. The reader is read-only (list-unit-files and show
only) and unions BOTH managers, because they disagree here: systemd-tmpfiles-clean.timer is
disabled/inactive for the user and static/active for the system. Hermetic: canned systemctl output, tmp
roots and ledgers; no systemctl, no crontab, no docker, no live state.
